item.description: 📢 𝗘𝗗𝗙 𝗻𝗲𝘄𝘀: 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝟲𝟬𝟬 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗮𝗹𝘀 𝘀𝘂𝗯𝗺𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗘𝗗𝗙 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘀! ➡️ The European Defence Fund (EDF) has attracted a record number of 612 project proposals under its 2026 calls marking an unprecedented level of interest: an increase of 49% compared to last year, demonstrating the growing relevance and attractiveness of the Fund. ➡️ With a €1.006 billion funding envelope available, established industrial actors and emerging innovators eager to collaborate on next-generation defence technologies have submitted their project proposals, with SME non-thematic calls raising particularly high interest. ➡️ For a first time the calls were open to Ukrainian applicants, in anticipation of the imminent entry into force of the association agreement of Ukraine to EDF. It is now time for a rigorous evaluation process: proposals undergo admissibility and eligibility reviews by the Commission services, before independent experts assist in the evaluation of scientific excellence, award criteria and ethics screenings. The results are expected to be announced by March 2027. 📍 More information: https://lnkd.in/emcgVW8Y Léo B. item.description: 📢 📢 4th call of the EUDIS Business Accelerator open for applicants! The EUDIS Business Accelerator programme supports European start-ups and scale-ups looking to strengthen their market readiness and build the right connections across the European defence ecosystem. The three main tech themes for this call will be the following: - Autonomous Systems & Robotics for Operational Advantage - Counter-Drone & Protection Against Mass Low-Cost Threats - Production, Sustainment and Logistics 20 selected companies will be granted access to an 8-month programme including on-site bootcamps across Europe, tailored coaching and training, access to testing facilities and technical expertise, and a €120,000 funding voucher. Applicants are asked to fill in the online application form, provide an evaluation deck and a video pitch presentation. The call is open until 16 November 2026, an online webinar will be organized on 29 October 2026. ➡️ More information on the programme, presentation webinar and applications: https://lnkd.in/e2hcwMZR Starburst Community, Starburst, Civitta, Ignity, VTT Hellenic Centre for Defence Innovation S.A., Estonian Defence and Aerospace Industry Association, Luxinnovation GIE, Léo B. item.title: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC...
item.description: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC work programme 2026 adopted on 17 June 2026 by the Commission to implement the Defence Mini-Omnibus, the EIC Accelerator and STEP Scaleup will from now on support companies developing dual-use technologies. Start-ups and SMEs developing technologies with a focus on dual-use business cases, both civilian and defence applications, can apply for grants up to €2.5 million and equity investments up to €30 million. ▶️ At the same time, the EIC is launching a new €100 million EIC STEP Defence Scale Up call, allowing companies in the EU Member States and countries associated to Horizon Europe to receive up to €30 million in direct equity financing in sectors such as air and missile defence, drones and counter drones, and other critical defence technologies. 🔎 This is the first time any EU funding programme will ever invest direct equity in defence companies. They can apply from 30 June until 28 October 2026, and the results are expected in early 2027. 👉 More information on the dedicated news article: https://lnkd.in/egVPTANM Léo B. item.title: 📢 New policy brief published by the Regions Dual-use Open Strategic Autonomy (REGDUALOSA) ! Prepared by the European Com...
item.description: 📢 New policy brief published by the Regions Dual-use Open Strategic Autonomy (REGDUALOSA) ! Prepared by the European Commission’s Joint Research Centre (JRC), this study examines how regional innovation policies across the EU can help strengthen dual-use and defence capacities, enabling regions to make the most of the growing defence market. The study features three case studies, Andalusia (Spain), Podkarpackie (Poland) and Estonia, and explores regional policies and financial mechanisms supporting dual-use and defence industries. It concludes with several identified gaps and success factors, and sets out 19 concrete policy recommendations that regions can use to strengthen their dual-use and defence industrial ecosystems. 📍 The policy brief is available here: https://lnkd.in/e557Hq9n Léo B. item.title: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual w...
item.description: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual work programme under the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), a new EU initiative meant to strengthen and modernise Europe’s defence industry, ramp-up production capacity and secure Europe’s technological edge and resilience. 📍Over EUR 700 million of EDIP are dedicated to reinforcing European defence production. European companies can apply to receive funding for Industrial Reinforcement Actions (IRA) and increase their manufacturing capacities for energetic components, key electronic components, and defence platforms and end-products. Two additional calls dedicated to Ukraine (USI-IRA) aim at reinforcing Ukrainian defence industrial production capacity in terms of missiles, ammunition and bombs and (counter-)drone systems. 📍 Funding rates for successful projects are between 35-100% of eligible project costs, depending on the respective call. First calls will open on 30 April and the very first call on energetic components will already close mid-June. ➡️ More details on the new EDIP webpage (tutorial videos, factsheets, timelines, application process) => https://lnkd.in/ePQrbrWG Léo B. item.description: 📌 Save the Date: ENDR Conference ”European Young Professionals Defence Summit 2026” in Malmö on 27 – 28 October 2026 In the framework of the European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Säkerhets- och försvarsföretagen (SOFF) - will host the ENDR conference “European Young Professionals Defence Summit”. Over two days in Malmö, participants will engage with leading experts and decision-makers through keynote speeches, panel discussions, interactive sessions, and networking activities. Discussions will address Europe's changing security environment, the defence market and industrial growth, skills development and workforce needs, and the relationship between technology, innovation, and operational effect. 👉 Further details on the agenda, confirmed speakers and registration on the dedicated webpage: https://lnkd.in/ezPNPPyM. item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. item.title: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All projec...
item.description: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project the Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster (CDICC) currently hosts in Slovenia the second training workshop for EDF National Focal Points, alternates, and other members of national EDF teams, aiming to strengthen NFP’s practical EDF support knowledge and skills. A particular focus is set on the Slovenian EDF experience (both from EDF consortium leaders and partners) and the management of IPR in EDF projects. The EOA project consortium took advantage of this onsite gathering to hold its annual General Assembly. To close the 3-day workshop the Slovenian Ministry of Defence will tomorrow present its experience with EDF participation and emerging challenges. Participants will also be introduced to the GOIS Grozd obrambne industrije Slovenije, g.i.z. with discussions on national approaches to innovation, research and development, and the exchange of good practices. ⏪ You can replay previous EOA training and webinar sessions on EDF best practices are available on EOA’s Youtube channel: https://lnkd.in/euKYVBz2. Stay tuned ! 🎙️ Aleš Lipnik, Doit-R Solutions Aleksander majeric, TECES, Green Tech Cluster), coordinator of the INDY, Energy independent and efficient deployable military camps project (EDF 2021) and partner in NOMAD PROJECT EU(EDF 2021) and Sentinel Project (EDF 2024) Iztok Spacapan, Instrumentation Technologies and the ARCHYTAS (EDF) project (EDF 2023) Žiga Mlinarič, SkyLabs d.o.o. and the Staalion project (EDF 2023 SME development action project) Jan Knezevic, SSRD and the Small UAS project (EDF 2024) Ziga Brencic, Jozef Stefan Institute and the SQORPION project (EDF 2024) 🙋‍♂️ Léo B., Alain Dinis 💡 🌎, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Grubesic Bruno The European Network of Defence-related Regions, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency.
